lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Two years ago, I couldn't order coffee without rehearsing it. Tonight, I'm gonna stand on that stage and sell them a whole empire.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You're up in three minutes. Just remember — when they push, don't rush. Take your time.
lines.direction: quiet, tense, right at his ear

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour, why do you care this much what happens to me tonight?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Because I put your name on that list. And after tonight... we need to talk.
lines.direction: honest, careful, a beat of weight

lines.speaker: Official
lines.text: Macal from Dune and Co. — you're on.
lines.direction: brisk, formal, calling into the room

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُمْ يا جَماعَة، أَنا مَحْمُود، وَمَعاكُمْ فِي حَلْقَة جْدِيدَة مِنْ يَلّا فْلُوِنْت! النَّهارْدَه، مَكَّال واقِفْ عَلى مَسْرَح رَايْزِينْج ڤُويْسِز... وَبِيِقَدِّمْ مَشْرُوعُه قُدّامْ النّاس!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: خَلّيكُمْ مَعايا، لِأَنُّوا اللِّيلَة هِنْتِعَلِّمْ إِزّايْ نِقْنِعْ حَدْ بِالإِنْجِلِيزِي... وَإِزّايْ نْكَسِّبْ وَقْتْ لَمّا نِتْلَخْبَطْ فِي سُؤالْ صَعْب!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: رَكِّزُوا مَعايا عَلى تَلاتَة تَعابِير: الأَوَّل "Let me walk you through it"... يَعْنِي خَلّينِي أُشْرَحْلَكْ خُطْوَة بِخُطْوَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَالتَّانِي "That's a great question"... وِدِي حِرْكَة ذَكِيَّة تِشْتَرِي بِها وَقْتْ قَبْلَ ما تِرُدّ! وَالتَّالِت "Let me come back to that"... لَمّا تِعْوِزْ تْأَجِّلْ إِجابَة! يَلّا، نِبْدَأ!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Macal, welcome. You have five minutes. Tell us why Macal Empire deserves this fellowship.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you. Let me walk you through it. Two years ago, I was an expat with a phone and an idea. Today, Dune and Co. runs on the system I built from scratch.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Impressive. But plenty of people build systems. What makes yours different?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: That's a great question. Most systems solve one problem. Mine solves three — hiring, training, and retention — in one platform. No one else in this room does that.

lines.speaker: Official
lines.text: How do you plan to scale across the Gulf? That's a big claim for a one-man operation.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Let me come back to that — because the answer connects to what the interviewer just asked. I'm not scaling alone. I have partners. I have proof. And I have three years of data right here.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Data you can share tonight?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Absolutely. I live here since two years, and every client I've worked with — every single one — renewed. That's not luck. That's a system that works.
lines.direction: energized, genuine, slight pause on claim

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Alright, Macal. You've got our attention. We'll be in touch.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You owned that room. I've never seen anyone handle a panel like that.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I couldn't have done it without you. So what was it you wanted to tell me?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Not here. But Macal — I put your name on that list because I believe in you. And after tonight, I might not be at Dune anymore.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَماعَة، تَعالُوا نْفَكِّكْ الحِوارْ دَه مَعَ بَعْض... مَكَّال اسْتَخْدَمْ تَلاتَة تَعابِير، وَكُلْ واحِدَة مِنُّهُمْ لِيها وَقْتْها بِالظَّبْط!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَوَّلْ تَعْبِير: Let me walk you through it... يَعْنِي خَلّينِي أُشْرَحْلَكْ الحِكايَة خُطْوَة بِخُطْوَة... بِنِسْتَخْدِمُه لَمّا الشَّرْحْ يِحْتاجْ تَرْتِيبْ، مِشْ رَمِي كَلامْ... مَثَلًا: Let me walk you through the numbers.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَعْبِيرْ تانِي: That's a great question... وِدِي حِرْكَة ذَكِيَّة... بْتَقُولْها عَشانْ تِشْتَرِي ثانْيِتين تِفَكِّرْ فِيهُمْ... وَبِتَخَلِّي السَّائِلْ حاسِسْ إِنِّكْ قَدَّرْتُه... مَثَلًا: That's a great question. Let me be specific.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَتَعْبِيرْ تالِت: Let me come back to that... يَعْنِي خَلِّينِي أِرْجَعْلَكْ لِلنُّقْطَة دِي بَعْدين... بِنِسْتَخْدِمُه لَمّا السُّؤالْ يِحْتاجْ تَفاصِيلْ كِتِيرْ، وَانْتَ عايِزْ تُكَمِّلْ أَوَّلْ... مَثَلًا: Let me come back to that in a moment.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: نِيجِي بَقَى لِلْغَلْطَة... مَكَّال قالْ: I live here since two years... وَدِي تَرْجَمَة حَرْفِيَّة مِنَ العَرَبِي... إِحْنا بْنِقُولْ "أَنا عايِشْ هِنا مِنْ سَنِتين"... بِسْ الإِنْجِلِيزِي بِيحِبْ Present Perfect مَعَ since... فَالصَّحْ: I've lived here for two years. جُمْلَة واحِدَة، خُدْها وَحُطَّها فِي جِيبَك!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: لاحْظُوا حاجَة كَمانْ... "since two years" غَلَطْ... "for two years" هُوَ الصَّحْ... since بِنِسْتَخْدِمْها مَعَ نُقْطَة زَمَنْ مُعَيَّنَة، زَيِّ since 2022... لَكِنْ for مَعَ المُدَّة... for two years... تَمامْ؟

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا، راجِعُوا الجُمَلْ دِي مَعايا... وَفِي المَشْهَدْ الجايْ، هِنْشُوفْ نُورْ هِتَقُولْ إِيهْ لِمَكَّال... وَإِزّايْ هُوَ هِيِتَعامَلْ مَعَ الخَبَرْ دَه!

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Come on, the terrace is quieter. You really didn't freeze up there. I was watching your hands — steady the whole time.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? My heart was going crazy. But once I said that first line, it just flowed. I've lived here for two years, and I've pitched to clients before. Tonight felt different, though — bigger.
lines.direction: relieved, honest, reusing corrected form naturally

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That's because it was. You weren't selling a product up there. You were selling yourself. And the room believed you.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — so the judges just walked out. When do we actually hear?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Tomorrow morning. They send the decision by email. No calls, no hints. Just open it and breathe.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Let me come back to what you started to say earlier — about Dune. What did you mean you might not be there?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: I put your name on that list because I knew you'd deliver. But Macal... there's a chance I go back to Chicago. My family's been asking. And I said yes to a maybe.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Tonight I felt like I could do anything. Now you're telling me the person who believed in me might just... leave.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Whatever happens tomorrow, you already won something up there. Don't forget that. Now go home and try to sleep. I'll text you.
lines.direction: reassuring, a small sad smile, exit line

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّبْ يا جَماعَة... كَمَّلْنا اللَّيْلَة مَعَ مَكَّال فِي Rising Voices... وَخُدْنا تَلاتَة تَعابِير حِرْكِيَّة: Let me walk you through it... That's a great question... وَ Let me come back to that.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفِي الأَخِرْ، الطَّبَقْ الرَّئِيسِي... بَرَضُه بِيِتْكَرَّرْ كِتِيرْ فِي الشُّغْلْ: Let me come back to that in a moment... جُمْلَة واحِدَة، تِشْتَرِي بِها وَقْتَكْ... وَتْخَلِّيكْ مُتَحَكِّمْ فِي الحِوارْ!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: نُورْ قالِتْ حاجَة مُهِمَّة... the person who believed in me might just leave... لاحْظُوا might just... يَعْنِي مُمْكِنْ بِسْ... بِتَخَفِّفْ الصَّدْمَة... تَمامْ؟

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا... تَعالُوا عَلى تِلِجْرامْ، وَاكْتُبُوا لِي: مَكَّال هَيِعْمِلْ إِيهْ بُكْرَة؟ وَاشْتَرْكُوا فِي البُودْكاسْتْ... عَشانْ تِتْعَلَّمُوا مَعانا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَفِي الحَلْقَةْ الجايَة... الإِيمِيلْ هَيِوْصَلْ... وَمَكَّال هَيِفْتَحْه... يا تُرَى هَيِقْرَا إِيهْ؟ اسْتَعِدُّوا... يَلّا، سَلامْ!
